trial_reels.note: Instagram Trial Reels (API trial_params, Meta Dec 2025): shown to non-followers first; needs >=200 followers on a professional account. Every 2nd post of the day is a trial; SS_PERFORMANCE auto-graduates winners. Self-activates when followers reach min.
